name: protest-force
description: Dispersal with no order identified, escalating to force against a peaceful assembly.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We are sitting quietly at the dharna, nobody is doing anything, it is peaceful.

turns.speaker: officer
turns.text: Sab log hato. Clear the area right now.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I asked which order is in force and he did not answer.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They have started lathi charge, they are hitting people who are just sitting.
